forecast_obs_notes: There is notable disagreement among NWP models: ECMWF is the coolest at 83.4°F, NBM sits at 85.0°F, and HRRR runs warmest at 88.1°F — a 4.7°F spread that reflects genuine uncertainty. max_temp_prediction: The META model's modal outcome is clearly 88-89°F (40.6%), with secondary shoulders at 86-87°F and 90-91°F (each ~22.8%), suggesting a most likely high in the upper 80s. HRRR at 88.1°F directly supports this range, and given a sunny, nearly cloud-free day in late June Atlanta, the HRRR's warm-season convective detail is credible. Confidence is moderate — the ensemble spread is meaningful and the ensemble abort signals flag elevated entropy — but the weight of evidence (META modal bucket + HRRR) points to approximately 88°F as the best single estimate.
